repoDetail.proxy.blockedAdminOnly: Only an administrator can block or unblock a repository.

apkKey.dialog.keyNameHint: Ends with .rsa.pub; left empty, the current or default name is used.
apkKey.dialog.keyNameInvalid: Use letters, digits, . _ @ + - and end with .rsa.pub.
apkKey.dialog.privateKeyHint: Paste a PEM private key (PKCS#8 or abuild's RSA key) to import it. Leave empty to generate a new key.
repoDelete.title: Delete repository
repoDelete.body: You are about to delete the repository "{name}".
repoDelete.trashHint: The repository and its contents are moved to the trash and kept for the configured retention period. An administrator can restore them from the trash until they are purged.
repos.settings.trashRetentionHint: How long deleted items stay in the trash before they are purged. Leave empty to use the server default; 0 deletes immediately without a trash.
repos.settings.trashRetentionInvalid: Retention must be empty or a whole number of days, 0 or more.
repos.settings.immutableReleasesHint: Release versions cannot be overwritten or deleted. Snapshots and pre-releases are not affected.
repos.settings.mergeProxyVersionsHint: By default, hosted members win a package name: proxy versions of a name that a hosted member holds are hidden. Enabling this merges them back in, which exposes the group to dependency confusion: a public package with the same name as an internal one could be installed.
repos.settings.signPackagesHint: New uploads are signed with the active GPG key. Existing packages are not re-signed. Requires an active key.
repos.settings.mergeProxyVersionsAdminOn: Only administrators can change this setting.

nixKey.name: Key name

curation.title: Curation
curation.subtitle: Decide which upstream packages and versions this proxy may serve. Hidden versions are left out of the package metadata and refused on download.
curation.mode.label: Curation mode
curation.mode.offHint: Every version is served; rules are not applied.
curation.modeFailed: Could not change the curation mode
curation.inactive: Rules are not applied while curation is off.
curation.allowlistEmpty: No allow rule yet: in an allowlist every version is unavailable until one is added.
curation.emptyHint: A rule names a package and, optionally, the versions it covers. Pick a mode, then add rules:
curation.exemptsMinAge: A matching allow rule also exempts a version from the repository's minimum age.
curation.action.blockHint: The matching versions are not served.
curation.action.allowHint: The matching versions are served and skip the minimum age.
curation.field.packageHint: Matched against the package name as the format normalizes it (npm: @scope/name, maven: group:artifact).
curation.field.versionHint: Leave empty to cover every version.
curation.field.reasonHint: Optional; shown to whoever is refused a version.
curation.globHelp: Patterns use * for any run of characters and ? for exactly one. Example: @acme/* with 2.* covers every 2.x version of every package in the @acme scope.
curation.deleteBody: The versions it covered are served or hidden according to the remaining rules.
curation.loadFailed: Could not load the curation rules
